sentences.text: For a floating-rate business loan sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026 to an MSE, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges only where the sanctioned amount or limit is up to ₹50 lakh. [E6, E8]
Because the loan amount in this case is ₹80 lakh, that no-charge threshold does not apply. [E8]

In cases other than those covered by that no-charge rule, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of the UCB, and for term loans they shall be based on the amount being prepaid. [E10, E11]
The charge also must be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and a charge that was not disclosed as specified there shall not be charged. [E15, E17]
